name: remove-filter-live-slot
source: local a=[1,2,3]; [std.filter(function(x) if x==1 then std.length(std.removeAt(a,0))>0 else true,a),a]

name: remove-fold-live-slots
source: local a=[1,2,3]; std.foldl(function(acc,x) if x==1 then acc+[std.length(std.removeAt(a,0))] else acc+[x],a,[])

name: remove-at-shared-result
source: local a=[1,2,3,4]; local b=std.removeAt(a,1); local c=std.removeAt(b,0); [c,b,a]

name: remove-at-copy-operations
source: local a=[1,2,3]; local b=a[:]; local c=a+[]; [std.length(b),std.length(c),std.removeAt(a,0),b,c,a]

name: flat-merge-comprehension-captures
source: std['$objectFlatMerge']([{[k]:k+v for k in [v]} for v in ['a','b','c']])

name: output-json-escaping
